statusNote: P0-P2 are complete. Windows 1 to 3 were denied and window 4 was only previewed. The operator restated the bound on 2026-11-13: the charter is judged at 15 to 20 CI-active branches on the wait from run creation to each required check. On main since then: the census fix (#3229), aggregates that take no runner when every shard succeeded (#3258), the first-parent diff base (#3249) and owner rows (#3255) from hosted-setup-tax, and the overflow routing (#3256, #3275). The overflow pool (prefix beep-ovf, at most 48 .2xlarge VMs) is applied and BEEP_SHARD_OVERFLOW has been on since 2026-11-13T19:48:48Z; no overflow VM had launched when this was written. Window 5 runs 2026-11-13T20:00Z to 2026-11-20T20:00Z and is censused on or after its end; a graph replay put Test Unit near the 20-minute line on a 17-branch day, so the window decides. If it passes: reflection and closeout in one final PR. If it is denied: attribute, repair and re-window.
mission: No required CI job waits 20 minutes (p95, not median): re-measure every lane cache-warm, then place each on the cheapest runner that meets the bar.

provenance.note: Carries the second co-primary outcome of the ci-fleet-endgame charter (speed-loop decision 54 lineage); split so the fleet packet can close on its infrastructure outcomes.
